decision.title: Selections from Michael Jackson's This Is It

input.title: Selections from Michael Jackson's This Is It

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (6 tracks) per . Verified digital-only EP. Wikipedia: 'The two versions of This Is It along with the second disc contents are available separately as the digital-only EP Selections from Michael Jackson's This Is It.' Alibris confirms: 'featured the single version of This Is It, an alternate mix featuring an orchestra, rare demo recordings.' The 6 tracks are the two 'This Is It' versions plus the four disc-2 tracks from the This Is It album, in that order.
